statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one further CVE with vendorProject Apple (any CVE other than CVE-2026-86950) carrying a dateAdded value between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-31 inclusive.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed lists any Apple vendorProject entry other than CVE-2026-86950 with dateAdded from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No Apple-vendor KEV entry other than CVE-2026-86950 carries a dateAdded within 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
